desc.en: It has arrived in the book Jannaat ul Khulood: While sneezing, it is recommended to indicate towards the nose with a finger and recited the following verses narrated from Imam Mahdi (a)…
desc.rurdu: Jannat-ul-Khulood mein mazkoor hai keh chheenk aane ke waqt mustahab hai keh beech ki ungli ko naak par rakhe aur is dua ko padhe jise Imam-e-Zamana (a) qaraa’at farmaaya…

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِیْنَ، وَصَلَّی اللهُ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِهٖ عَبْدًا ذَاكِرًا لِلهِ، غَیْرَ مُسْتَنْكِفٍ وَلَا مُسْتَكْبِرٍ۔

lines.rarabic: AL-HAMDO LILLAAHE RABBIL A’A-LAMEENA, WA SALLAL LAAHO A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE-HI A’BDAN ZAAKE-RAN LILLAAHE, GHAIRA MUSTAN-KEFIN WA LAA MUSTAK-BERIN.

trans.en: All praises be for Allah, the Lord of the worlds, and may Allah bless Mohammad and his Progeny, while we are his servants whom remember Him, without being ignorant or arrogant.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
